verdict.rationale: Plausible publishes an official self-hosting guide for Plausible Community Edition, and community users confirm years of self-hosting the FOSS product. One user calls setup heavier than needed because it requires ClickHouse; that is a complexity caveat, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party detail beyond a single getting-started guide mention, evidence on feature parity between Community Edition and the hosted product, and lighter-weight deployment requirements.
